about.title: About and methodology
about.subtitle: Public-interest informational tool developed by Group 5, JAIN (Deemed-to-be University).
about.projectScope: Scheme Access Kit provides verified, accessible information on agricultural schemes for farmers across India, addressing administrative opacity and documentation bottlenecks.
about.methodStep1: 1. Gazette-level grounding: Every scheme rule is traced back to an official government order, gazette notification, or published operational guideline.
about.methodStep2: 2. Explicit hypothesis flagging: Where state rules vary or leave operational ambiguity, recommendations are marked as hypotheses.
about.methodStep3: 3. Zero personal data architecture: No Aadhaar numbers, bank account numbers, or land record numbers are ever solicited, stored, or transmitted.
about.teamRole: Student researchers and software engineers, JAIN (Deemed-to-be University)
about.reportErrorDesc: If an official rule or contact detail has updated in your area, submit a report for verification.
